struct FlowEdge {
    int v, u;
    ll cap, flow;
    FlowEdge(int v, int u, ll c) : v(v), u(u), cap(c), flow(0) {}
};

struct Dinic {
    const ll INF = 1e18;
    vector<FlowEdge> edges;
    vector<vector<int>> adj;
    int n, m = 0, s, t;
    vector<int> level, ptr;
    queue<int> q;

    Dinic(int n, int s, int t) : n(n), s(s), t(t) {
        adj.resize(n);
        level.assign(n, -1);
        ptr.resize(n);
    }

    void add_edge(int v, int u, ll cap) {
        edges.emplace_back(v, u, cap);
        edges.emplace_back(u, v, 0);
        adj[v].push_back(m++);
        adj[u].push_back(m++);
    }

    bool bfs() {
        fill(level.begin(), level.end(), -1);
        level[s] = 0;
        q.push(s);
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int v = q.front(); q.pop();
            for (int idx : adj[v]) {
                auto& e = edges[idx];
                if (e.cap - e.flow <= 0 || level[e.u] != -1) continue;
                level[e.u] = level[v] + 1;
                q.push(e.u);
            }
        }
        return level[t] != -1;
    }

    ll dfs(int v, ll flow) {
        if (v == t || flow == 0) return flow;
        for (int& i = ptr[v]; i < (int)adj[v].size(); ++i) {
            int idx = adj[v][i];
            auto& e = edges[idx];
            if (level[e.u] != level[v] + 1 || e.cap - e.flow <= 0) continue;
            ll pushed = dfs(e.u, min(flow, e.cap - e.flow));
            if (pushed == 0) continue;
            e.flow += pushed;
            edges[idx ^ 1].flow -= pushed;
            return pushed;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    ll max_flow() {
        ll result = 0;
        while (bfs()) {
            fill(ptr.begin(), ptr.end(), 0);

            }
        }
        return result;
    }
